title: 群侠传，启动！
notes: Started from Highball's library (`steam.exe -silent -applaunch 2098790`), played for 12 minutes 36 seconds (11:28:45 to 11:41:21): the world map, the tavern at 河洛客栈, and a dialogue scene at 南贤居. I resized the window during the session, so the four captures I took are 3830x2158, 3820x2152, 1921x1085 and 3840x2160. Heads up on what was actually running: 群侠传，启动！ is a framework that loads user-made games through a mod loader (`Scene 0_MODLoaderScene`, `MOD.UI.ModPanelNew`, `CurrentModId` / `CurrentModConfig`), and this run was a Workshop mod, not the content the game ships with. It was Steam Workshop item 2865676700 — `steamapps/workshop/content/2098790/2865676700/plus.xml` reads `Id="plus" Name="群侠世界语音版" Author="都市断想" Version="20250113"`, described as an enhanced version of 《金庸群侠传3D重制版》, 800 MB across `plus_mod` and `plus_maps`. The saves went to `AppData/LocalLow/jynew/群侠传启动/plus/`. So read this as the framework plus that mod. Frame rate on the Metal HUD (bottom left), at the four moments I captured: 112.28, 97.96, 122.29 and 146.56 fps. The game's own settings (`Jyx2_PlayerPrefs.json`) are fullscreen 1, resolution 1920x1080, vsync on, `GraphicSetting-MaxFps` 200, so 160 Hz is the ceiling and these readings sit below it. No stutter, no hitch, nothing that interrupted play. Unity (Mono), 64-bit, D3D11 (feature level 11_1). DXMT loaded and did not fall back to wined3d: `wuxia_launch_dxgi.log` and `wuxia_launch_d3d11.log` both exist and are empty, i.e. the renderer wrote no errors. One thing the game's own `Player.log` records, in case it is worth knowing and is not specific to this layer: quitting from the main menu leaves `InvalidOperationException: try to dispose a LuaEnv with C# callback!` (`Jyx2.RuntimeEnvSetup.ForceClear` ← `MOD.UI.ModPanelNew.SwitchSceneTo` ← `GameMainMenu.OnQuitGameClicked`), plus a `LuaException` about `CurrentModConfig` being nil. It lands after the game has already gone back to the menu, and the previous session has the same trace, so it reads as the mod's teardown rather than anything about the run. One earlier data point: the previous run of this game in my logs (2026-10-07, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r21 + dxvk) ended in `wine: Unhandled page fault on execute access to 79CDF1C9 at address 79CDF1C9`, with winedbg starting (`# exit=0 after 123s`). Today's run on x64-crossover26.3-r19 + dxmt had no such fault. For the page: the Steam store carries no English title — `appdetails?appids=2098790&l=english` still returns `群侠传，启动！` — so the slug needs a romanisation.
